How Ward Cunningham connects

  • Topic: Wiki — Ward Cunningham invented the wiki and the first WikiWikiWeb.

What is Ward Cunningham?

Ward Cunningham shipped the first wiki in 1995. Wikipedia borrowed the edit-anyone page model, not his Portland Pattern Repository's content.

Key threads lead to Wiki.
